notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
NEW & IMPROVEMENTS

Added Russian localization.
Added an option to play on a resizable window (only available in main menu).
Added Buttons in game under the Season Dial to speed up(x2), slow down (x0.5) or stop time.
Added a game tool to enable or disable manual fire, to prevent undesired fires on click.
Added a game tool to control clouds opacity to improve visibility with a thick layer of clouds, fog and smoke.
Added a game setting to select terrain size. 
⚠WARNING⚠ While playing on smaller terrain can improve performances, playing on bigger terrains could have a noticeable impact on your performances on lower configurations.
Added world weather stats displaying clouds cover (average humidity) and world temperature.
Added a new tool to replace any plant with a plant of your choice: The Tile Painter.
Added a shortcut (F1) to open the Encyclopedia in game.
Added an access to Credits in the main menu.


FIXES
Fixed Pause Menu not opening on game menu screen if closed on another screen.
Fixed an issue where clicking on buttons would prevent camera movement.
Fixed an issue where the cursor would remain hidden in the Pause Menu if HUD was hidden.
